Quilt values of each MP across OMs, as a dot plot

Source: R/Slick_plots.R
PlotQuiltDots.Rd

Plots one Quilt performance indicator for each MP and OM, with the value in a reference OM (e.g. the Base Case) highlighted, to show how much the performance of each MP varies among the OMs.

Usage

PlotQuiltDots(
  slick,
  PI = 1,
  MPs = NULL,
  OMs = NULL,
  ref_OM = 1,
  x_by = NULL,
  color_by = NULL,
  colors = NULL,
  ylab = NULL,
  xlab = NULL,
  color_title = NULL,
  base_size = 11,
  base_family = "serif"
)

Arguments

slick

A Slick object.

PI

Index or code of the Quilt performance indicator.

MPs

Codes or indices of the MPs. Defaults to all.

OMs

Codes or indices of the OMs. Defaults to all.

ref_OM

Code or index of the reference OM, highlighted.

x_by, color_by

Vectors (one per MP, or named by MP code) giving the x-axis position and colour of each MP (e.g. HCR and MP type).

colors

Optional colours for the levels of color_by.

ylab, xlab, color_title

Labels.

base_size, base_family

Passed to theme_slick_print().

Value

A ggplot2 object.

Details

Candidate Slick plot: a by-OM view of the Quilt values (see PlotQuiltOM()).
